motion.name: state

motion.name: enter-stagger
motion.value: home: words 0 + 50ms step (name), 150ms + 50ms step (role); blocks 0 / 400 / 500 / 600ms (avatar, bio, projects, writing). article: breadcrumb 0, title words from 100ms, meta 300, caption + article 400, contents 500

motion.name: morph

motion.name: disclosure

motion.name: action-swap
motion.value: letters spring (stiffness 460, damping 30, mass 0.55), 25ms stagger, 3px blur; exit 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) at half stagger; resets after 2s
motion.purpose: Copy link label and icon roll on copy; the code box copy button rolls its icon copy to check (beUI Action Swap, vendored).

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Copy link and code copy button press feedback.

motion.name: scene
motion.value: 15fps canvas, only while visible; inside a link or a [data-hover-play] card (home tile, gallery scenes) it plays only on hover/focus; still frame under reduced motion
motion.purpose: Seeded halftone scene animation, pointer light and tap effects on the article.

narrative.overview:
One narrow column of text on a near-black neutral ground. The copy and the work carry the page; the interface recedes until a link or a row is touched. Hierarchy comes from weight and tone, never from size: everything is Inter at 16px, separated into three ink tiers and set apart by generous vertical space.

The world is brief-pinned. Its form follows the user's four reference sites (Jakub Krehel, Lee Robinson, Emil Kowalski, interfaces.dev); no concept roll ran, seed key "none (pinned)". It is dark only and carries no accent color. Detail lives in small, deliberate touches: hairline underlines, 1.5px stroke icons in currentColor, faint inset rings, one staggered blur-up entrance.

Writing extends the column without changing it. A post is the same column plus one living figure: a seeded halftone scene (time of day, place, landmark) drawn as dithered dots on a canvas. That figure is the only colour in the world, and it is art, not interface. Everything around it (breadcrumb, title, contents, prose, code) stays in the ink tiers at one size.

Articles also carry four richer blocks, all authored in markdown and rendered to static HTML at build time: a code box with a file header, a flow diagram, a framed image, and a gallery of live scenes. They stay in the same neutral tiers; the gallery is the Art Exception repeated, not a new one. The few parts that need the client (copy buttons, live scenes) mount into placeholders the HTML leaves.
keyCharacteristics: Single 576px column, top-left aligned; the article figure, framed images, scene galleries, code boxes and the contents rail are the only things allowed outside it.
One type size (16px); hierarchy by weight (500 vs 400) and ink tier. Code is the one deliberate step down (Geist Mono 14px).
Neutral greys only in the interface; full colour lives inside the seeded scene art and nowhere else.
Hairline underlines and inset 1px rings instead of borders and shadows.
Motion is one staged entrance, 150ms hover state changes, and one shared-element morph from tile to figure.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: The interface has no hue. Emphasis is earned by moving up an ink tier (muted, soft, full), never by color.

rules.name: The Art Exception
rules.body: The seeded scene is the one place full colour is allowed, and it stays inside the art. Scene colour never reaches text, links, rings, or fills outside the canvas. The seed is never shown; the scene is captioned only by its generated two-word name (time word plus place word, first letter capitalised) in Muted Ink.

rules.name: The Three Tiers Rule
rules.body: Text uses exactly three tones: full ink for things you can act on or name, soft ink for prose, muted ink for supporting lines. A fourth tone is drift. Syntax highlighting in code is the scoped case: it stays on the same neutral axis (keywords, classes and entities full ink; identifiers, properties and JSX text at 80%; strings at 60%; punctuation and comments muted), never hued. Code line numbers are the other scoped case: gutter marks at ink 28%, below muted, because they are a ruler, not text.

rules.name: The Lit Node Rule
rules.body: Inside article blocks, emphasis is a step up the same neutral axis, never a hue. A lit flow node takes a stronger fill (ink at 7%) and ring (ink at 18%), and its icon goes to full ink on an ink-at-12% tile; a marked code line takes a full-width ink-at-6% band.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: All text is 16px, article titles included (user-confirmed). New sections get hierarchy from weight 500, ink tier, and space, not from a larger size. The only exception is code, set at 14px / 0.875em so it matches Inter optically.

rules.name: The Inset Edge Rule
rules.body: Containers are defined by a 1px inset ring, never by an outer shadow or a solid border.

rules.name: The Concentric Corner Rule
rules.body: A rounded thing inside a rounded thing takes the outer radius minus the gap between them: a flow node is 14px because its 6px icon tile sits 8px in; a row's focus outline is 14px because it sits 4px outside a 10px tile.

dos: Do keep every new section inside the 576px column, separated by 80px, with a weight-500 16px heading 16px above its content.
Do use the three ink tiers: full for names and links, 70% for prose, muted for supporting lines.
Do draw icons from Central Icons (round-outlined, radius 2, 1.5px stroke) in currentColor.
Do signal interactivity with the 25% to 60% underline shift and 150ms transitions.
Do gate entrance motion behind reduced-motion and keep it to one staged reveal.
Do keep scene colour inside the canvas, and caption a scene with its generated name only.
Do set code in Geist Mono at 14px (0.875em inline) so it matches Inter 16px optically.
Do let full-bleed elements on phones go square and edge-to-edge; give them 14px corners and an inset edge once they sit inside the column.
Do mark what matters in an article block by stepping up the neutral axis (a lit node, a marked line), never with a hue.
Do nest corners concentrically: inner radius equals outer radius minus the gap.
donts: Don't introduce an accent color; the interface is neutral by commitment, and the scene art is the only exception.
Don't raise font size for hierarchy; the system is one size, article titles included.
Don't show a post's seed or any technical scene parameter to the reader.
Don't use drop shadows or solid borders on containers; use the 1px inset ring.
Don't ship a light theme; the system is dark only.
Don't set readable text below 14px; the 9px language badge is a mark, hidden from assistive tech, and the only exception.
